advice.headline: Stay the course
reasons: You're 6-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 18%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 10 contenders (151.4 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 2nd in 2028 (title chances about 18%, 24%, 24%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (5 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
